messages:
jordan.prod: Hey support — customers reporting periodic embed responses with the wrong vector length and intermittent tail latency spikes. Started after they upped max_batch_size in their client to 512.
liz.support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the minimal repro and any logs you have? Is this a single customer or multiple? Any recent model changes?
jordan.prod: Single customer for now. No model change on our side; they're using text-embedding-3-large (1536 dim). Quick curl they ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["a","b","c","d"],"max_batch_size":512}'
```
Response sometimes returns ok but with vectors length 0 or 768 for some items, and the latency jumps to 1.2s tail. Other times it's normal (~120ms).
sam.eng-runtime: tagging eng-runtime. This smells like mixed-variant batching or a padding/truncation bug in the coalescer. Do we have the batcher logs for that timeframe? mike.oncall: I grabbed the shard logs from 2026-01-12T18:22:40Z — here's the dynbatch coalescer dump around the spike (sanitized):
```
[18:22:40.123] coalescer: received req id=cid-43 size=1536 seq=1
[18:22:40.124] coalescer: received req id=cid-44 size=1536 seq=1
[18:22:40.125] coalescer: received req id=cid-45 size=768 seq=1
[18:22:40.126] coalescer: forming batch batch_id=bt-987 total_elems=3 target_max=512
[18:22:40.127] batch_dispatch: kernel_select => variant=quant_f16 model_variant=small
[18:22:40.127] rpc: dispatched to worker w-12 (variant=small)
[18:22:40.220] worker w-12: finished; wrote 3 embeddings -> shapes [1536,1536,768]
[18:22:40.221] responder: mapping back -> mismatch detected for req cid-45, zeroing vector
```
sam.eng-runtime: Ah — note req cid-45 shows 768. That means somewhere upstream a request carrying a different model or an earlier smaller embed made it into the same coalesced batch. Coalescer should enforce homogeneous model variant by model id + dim. Investigate why size=768 arrived.
liz.support: Jordan, did the customer have multiple model names in the same client process? Or are they switching model param dynamically? jordan.prod: They said they switched to a new SDK that auto-fills max_batch_size=512 but didn't change model. However their logs include one odd internal task that calls text-embedding-3-small for quick checks.
mike.oncall: Repro idea: send a stream of small requests for text-embedding-3-large but inject an occasional text-embedding-3-small and set a high max_batch_size to encourage coalescing. If coalescer allows mixing, we'll reproduce.
```bash
# reproduce script
for i in {1..200}; do
  if (( i % 37 == 0 )); then
    model=text-embedding-3-small
  else
    model=text-embedding-3-large
  fi
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"'$model'","input":["x"] ,"max_batch_size":512}' &
  sleep 0.01
done
```
sam.eng-runtime: If repro works, immediate mitigation: set a server-side guard to reject mixed-model coalescing (quick patch), and ask customer to set max_batch_size lower (64) or pin requests to one model per client process. Also adding a runtime assertion to log ancestry (client id) for any mismatched dims for faster triage.
jordan.prod: Customer tried lower max_batch_size=64 and tail latency stabilized, no more zeroed vectors. They want a root cause and a permanent fix.
liz.support: Escalating to eng-runtime. Sam, can you open a quick PR to add a model-id+dim equality check inside coalescer? Add metrics for "coalescer_mixed_model_attempts" and alert if >0. Also add a short-term automated fallback: if mismatch detected, split the batch and route items to correct variant rather than zeroing.
sam.eng-runtime: Yep. I'll drop a patch and a hotfix pipeline alert. Also planning to add a diagnostic flag we can enable for the customer's org to trace per-request model headers.
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued for patch/eng-runtime/#1123 -> canary to shard group alpha at 18:50 UTC.
mike.oncall: Once canary is up, I'll run the inject-repro to confirm. Jordan, please schedule a follow-up with the customer in ~30m.
jordan.prod: Thanks all — customer notified. I'll update thread after canary results. :thumbsup:
